resource_lease_reason: Reads existing assets for bounded CPU/GPU inference; no whole-disk monopoly for ordinary reads or downloads.
selection: All11source-selected matched choices frozen in previous preparation, including unchanged donors; no probability/target-based selection.
intervention: Original difference formulas andfourmaps/rank1/common sourcecap.1 unchanged; donor constraint only, no position permutations or enlarged pools.
budget: Fixed11source-selected pairs: original2/expanded9 at19forwards=209. <=2min inference+2min export/metric accumulation. No training/refit/newdata/audit.
scope_limit: Previous selected matched pair pool only, old documents and centered-logit outcomes already exposed. New probability endpoints frozen before evaluation; not independent confirmation or semantic ground truth.

probability_endpoints.primary: intervention_positions with valid within-document observed next token
probability_endpoints.secondary: union of same-document positions downstream from an intervention, excludes EOS predictions and final unavailable token
probability_endpoints.kl: sum KL(P_source||P_candidate) / sum KL(P_source||P_baseline); float64 log-softmax; denominator <=1e-12*positions yields null
probability_endpoints.nll: observed next-token NLL intervention-minus-baseline vector; report signed means, RMS and normalized squared vector error; source squared energy <=1e-12*positions yields null
probability_endpoints.scope: joint multi-position interventions, not independent position attribution; secondary suffix may condition on preceding packed documents but no later document positions scored
